quest.title: Where the Light Wanes
quest.description: While everyone else is lifting their eyes up to the lovely sight of Xiao Lanterns in the sky, Millelith soldier Hongyu is having a headache...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: How did I end up doing this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Xiao Lanterns don't just vanish into thin air after each Lantern Rite, you know? They have to be recovered manually.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Sure, they are quite a view, floating majestically in the air, but at the same time, they can also be quite a nuisance.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: If its lampshade is poorly made, a lantern will break mid-air, leaving only a chunk of Plaustrite that flies all over the place.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Some Xiao Lanterns also get blown away by the wind and end up stuck in random nooks...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: The former creates safety concerns, while the latter litters the city landscape. So the Ministry of Civil Affairs usually delegates the responsibility of recovering Xiao Lanterns to a specific person.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: As it happens, it's my turn this year...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: But the amount of Xiao Lanterns released during the festival is overwhelming... If I were to retrieve them all the day after the celebrations end, I'd be done for.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: So the only feasible way is to remove the broken and misplaced lanterns gradually, as people release them.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Even so, I doubt I can collect them all on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Traveler, would you mind checking a few spots for Xiao Lanterns that need to be recovered?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: I've marked the locations on the map for you. Thanks for your help!

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to collect the Xiao Lantern

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: That's not fair!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: I... Ugh, let me start from the beginning. My master recently developed a new kicking technique. An immensely powerful one at that!

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: But he claimed that I wasn't earnest enough, and that I still needed to work on the basics. He wouldn't teach me the new technique...

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: I planned to take advantage of the Lantern Rite and give him a nice Xiao Lantern to soften his attitude. Perhaps a change of mood would lead to a change of heart, and he'd agree to teach me those moves, or so I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: But I couldn't find any Plaustrite, so when I noticed that a Xiao Lantern got stuck over there, I wanted to retrieve the Plaustrite inside...

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: You saw what happened next... Eh, I don't deserve that Xiao Lantern. You can have it.

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: Encountering those monsters really made me realize that my martial arts foundations leave a lot to be desired...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Have you checked all the spots I marked for you yet? Any Xiao Lanterns recovered?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Three Xiao Lanterns altogether.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Thanks so much. It would have been a lot of work to retrieve the Xiao Lanterns in those places. The trip tires me right out each time...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: With your help, I can finally rest easy. So please, take this for your trouble. You've more than earned it.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to collect the Xiao Lantern

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: They release them, I take them back, and so on and so forth. Am I the only one who sees no point in this?

dialogues.speaker: Flash-Fist Ling
dialogues.text: It's all because I'm too weak. I have a long way to go to fully grasp my master's teachings.

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to collect the Xiao Lantern
